LanguageData.VFEI2_Gigalocust.description: A genetically-engineered hunter drone the size of an elephant. It can fly over long distances, dropping down on unsuspecting targets, ripping them to shreds with its several sets of ripper-blades and sharp mandibles. It is, however, quite slow in open terrain.
